notes: Resolve [us] -> target_code by scanning country_code dict at runtime; build cn_pass[cn_row] = (country_code_bin[cn_row] == target_code). Since cn.id is dense identity, cn_pass is directly indexable by mc.company_id.
Resolve target_k_id by scanning keyword/keyword.dat using offsets; break on first match.

Driver loop: for k_pos in [off[target_k_id], off[target_k_id+1]): mk_row = rowids[k_pos]; mv = mk.movie_id[mk_row]. For each mv, iterate mc CSR; if cn_pass[mc.company_id[r]] then read title.title[mv] and update local min.
title.id is dense identity (rows=2528312), so mv directly indexes title varlen offsets.
Avoid materializing full title strings; compare std::string_view against current best and only copy on improvement.
No sampling needed: keyword filter selectivity ~1/134k makes mk slice small (low thousands), the bottleneck is well-characterized.
